feeds.title: Alabama Men Blog
feeds.description: Alabama Men A ministry of the Alabama Baptist State Board of Missions devoted to helping men be missional and intentional in making disciples. A little book is making a big impact on the discipleship of new believers. 'First Letters: Basic Truths for a New Believer'by Larry Hyche is a plainly written Christian primer.

feeds.title: Alabama Worship Blog
feeds.description: Alabama Worship Blog seeks to help identify and equip your church with any Worship Leadership needs to proclaim the gospel through music. That includes music, worship events, instrumental needs, sound consultations, networking and more. Read the blog to get updates.

feeds.title: The Alabama Baptist
feeds.description: The Alabama Baptist has its readers' Christian walk in mind, seeking to empower them to live out discipleship in their personal, professional and church life. It aims to equip them with resources and information and to do that with competence, compassion, fairness and dependability as a news source.

feeds.title: Covenant Presbyterian Church Blog
feeds.description: As elected elders serving on the Session of Covenant Presbyterian Church, we have been given the responsibility to lead and guide our particular fellowship as we seek to follow our Lord Jesus Christ. We want to be faithful disciples who love God, love one another, and serve in the world. We live in rapidly changing and exciting times. It is a good time to be a part of the Church, the body of Christ. However, we face many formidable challenges. One of the greatest is discerning what is essential to our faith as we find ourselves in an increasingly secular and pluralistic world.

feeds.title: Plant Alabama Blog
feeds.description: Because it takes all kinds of churches to reach all kinds of people… We encourage the starting of new congregations We facilitate the starting of new congregations We equip those starting new congregations We resource the starting of new congregations.

feeds.title: Jason Sears Blog
feeds.description: Jason Sears is the Worship Pastor at Oak Mountain Presbyterian Church. Oak Mountain is a contemporary-style PCA church in the suburbs of Birmingham, Alabama. All recaps of Sunday's service, praise and worship songs on Spotify, tweets, and more can be found here.

feeds.title: John Ed Mathison Blog
feeds.description: In each episode of 'Got a Minute,' John Ed Mathison will share a small piece of wisdom. Find Christ centered lessons and daily thoughts about how to bring yourself closer to Christ all written by veteran pastor John Ed Mathison!

feeds.title: Dr. Harry L. Reeder III
feeds.description: Topics and issues of life in Biblical perspective with Harry Reeder, Pastor/Teacher at Briarwood Presbyterian Church (PCA) in Birmingham, Alabama.

feeds.title: Word Alive International Outreach Blog
feeds.description: An epicenter of freedom & transformation. Transforming lives, our state, & nations! Follow Word Alive International Outreach blog to receive important updates about how they are rising up and reaching out to those around us, spiritual encouragement, church news and so much more.

feeds.title: Eastmont Baptist Church Blog
feeds.description: Eastmont is committed to showing and sharing the message of Christ with love and compassion. We want to see lives transformed, broken hearts healed, and families restored in Montgomery and the River Region.

feeds.title: Evangelize Alabama Blog
feeds.description: The Evangelism Ministry of the Alabama Baptist State Board of Missions.The office of evangelism exists to encourage and equip Christians to share the good news of Jesus Christ.
